'''Orl Miscord''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Skyholme Lucites|Skyholme Lucite]] who masqueraded as a beast tamer with the caravan of exotic beasts owned by [[Sala Vindako]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]].

==Biography==
A [[Skyholme Lucites|Skyholme Lucite]], Orl Miscord was duplicitous and obsessed with obtaining the [[Grimoire of Syclos the Lame]]. When rumor reached him the businesswoman [[Sala Vindako]] was in possession of the book, he joined her caravan as a sage and beast tamer, helping her capture a [[dust stalker]] in the [[Madlands]]. As the caravan passed through [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]], Miscord released the dust-stalker in hopes that it would kill Vindako so that he might take possession of the ancient book. He wielded a [[Staff/Legends|staff]] imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and a razor-dagger he kept concealed in his sleave.<ref name="NoP" />
